import sys
import math

def perform_transform(a, n, p, invert):
    logn = n.bit_length() - 1
    for i in range(logn):
        step = 1 << i
        for mask in range(n):
            if mask & step:
                prev_mask = mask ^ step
                if not invert:
                    a[mask] = (a[mask] + a[prev_mask]) % p
                else:
                    a[mask] = (a[mask] - a[prev_mask] + p) % p

def power_convolution(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a
    if k % 2 == 1:
        prev = power_convolution(a, k - 1, p)
        result = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                result[i + j] = (result[i + j] + prev[i] * a[j]) % p
        return result
    else:
        half = power_convolution(a, k // 2, p)
        result = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                result[i + j] = (result[i + j] + half[i] * half[j]) % p
        return result

def subset_power_convolution(a, k, p):
    LOGN = 19
    n = len(a)
    while n & (n - 1):
        n += 1
    fa = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    fc = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        for j in range(n):
            if bin(j).count('1') == i:
                fa[i][j] = a[j] if j < len(a) else 0
            else:
                fa[i][j] = 0
            fc[i][j] = 0
        perform_transform(fa[i], n, p, False)
    for i in range(n):
        v = [fa[j][i] for j in range(LOGN)]
        v = power_convolution(v, k, p)
        for j in range(LOGN):
            fc[j][i] = v[j]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        perform_transform(fc[i], n, p, True)
        for j in range(n):
            if bin(j).count('1') == i:
                a[j] = fc[i][j]
    return a

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, k, p = map(int, input[:3])
    data = list(map(int, input[3:]))

    temp_n = n
    f = [0] * (1 << 20)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        if (n & i) == i:
            mask = 0
            for j in range(20):
                mask <<= 1
                if n & (1 << j):
                    mask |= 1 if (i & (1 << j)) else 0
            f[mask] = i
            temp_n = max(temp_n, mask)

    if n & 1:
        print(pow(k, n, p))
        return

    MAXN = 10**6 + 5
    fact = [1] * MAXN
    for i in range(1, MAXN):
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p
    inv_fact = [1] * MAXN
    inv_fact[MAXN - 1] = pow(fact[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p)
    for i in reversed(range(1, MAXN - 1)):
        inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

    a = [0] * (temp_n + 1)
    for i in range(temp_n + 1):
        a[i] = inv_fact[f[i]]

    res = pow(k, n, p)
    a = subset_power_convolution(a, k, p)
    subtract_value = (a[temp_n] * fact[n]) % p
    res = (res - subtract_value + p) % p
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
